==Description==
This plugin can duplicate/copy an UNICASE project. UNICASE Projects can automatically be shared with EMFStore Server.

===Contact===
Alexander Delater (delater@informatik.uni-heidelberg.de) 

===Link to update-site===

Please use the following update-site for installing the plugin:
http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/duplicate/update (Available soon)

===Tutorial for users===
Open context-menu on UNICASE Project and select “Duplicate” or “Duplicate and Share”:
 

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/plugin-resources/duplicateprojects1.png]


Afterwards, a dialog is opened where one can specify the name and the number of duplicated projects to be created.

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/other/heidelberg/plugin-resources/duplicateprojects2.png]
